items.reason: A gentle, non-stripping cleanser suits skin that looks very low in moisture.
Hyaluronic acid adds hydration that can soften the look of fine lines on dry-looking skin.
A moderate-strength retinol at night is a well-known cosmetic choice for the look of lines and uneven texture.
A rich ceramide cream supports the skin barrier and adds comfort and a plumper look, which also helps skin tolerate retinol.
A mineral SPF 50 is needed every morning when using retinol and helps protect against further visible signs of aging.

response.routine_note: Mornings: cleanse, apply hyaluronic serum, then moisturizer and sunscreen. Evenings: cleanse, apply hyaluronic serum, then retinol 2 nights a week and build up slowly as comfortable, followed by moisturizer; skip exfoliating acids to avoid irritation.
